rounds.intent: Add a release condition to the existing Cargo connection: when Player speed exceeds 0.5, detach Cargo and leave it where it was. Keep the current slow pickup conditions and Player movement.
Remove the release rule: moving quickly must no longer drop Cargo. Only acquiring Cargo should require a slow approach. Leave Player movement unchanged.

body.reply: I've added a rule that detaches Cargo from the Player when the Player's speed exceeds 0.5.
The rule that detached Cargo when Player moved quickly has been removed. Cargo will now remain attached regardless of Player's speed.
